actions.title: Apex System Snapshot
actions.description: Read system state on demand without polling in the background.

actions.title: Windows Update
actions.description: Open the supported Windows Update settings page. Apex does not change update policy.

actions.title: Storage settings
actions.description: Open Windows Storage settings for a reviewable view of cleanup candidates; Apex does not delete files.

actions.title: Reduce visual effects
actions.description: Favor performance for this user's visual effects. Restore returns to Windows-managed defaults.

actions.title: Startup application inventory
actions.description: List current-user Run registry startup entries. No startup entries are disabled by this inventory action.

actions.title: Disable selected startup entry
actions.description: ADVANCED: prevent a selected current-user Run registry app from launching automatically. The original value is backed up for restore. Other users, services, scheduled tasks, and Startup-folder items are untouched.

actions.title: Startup Apps settings
actions.description: Open Windows Startup Apps so you can control individual startup entries.

actions.title: Background app settings
actions.description: Open Windows Installed apps settings for per-app background permissions. Apex does not disable services.

actions.title: Search and indexing settings
actions.description: Open Windows Search settings. Windows Search service remains enabled and unchanged.

actions.title: Indexing Options
actions.description: Open Control Panel Indexing Options to inspect locations and file types without disabling the Windows Search service.

actions.title: Apex Gaming Mode
actions.description: Enable Game Mode and disable Game DVR capture for this user; save original registry values for restore.

actions.title: Game Mode settings
actions.description: Open the supported Windows Game Mode settings page. Apex does not change Xbox authentication or Gaming Services.

actions.title: Game Bar settings
actions.description: Open Windows Game Bar settings to review its UI and capture preferences. Apex Gaming Mode separately disables background Game DVR capture for this user.

actions.title: Per-app GPU preference
actions.description: Open Windows Graphics settings to choose a GPU preference for a specific game. Apex does not guess the correct GPU.

actions.title: Balanced
actions.description: Use Windows' normal per-app background policy. This does not promise free RAM or clear memory caches.

actions.title: Aggressive
actions.description: ADVANCED: block supported Store apps from background activity using the current-user Windows policy. Some app notifications or syncing may stop; the previous policy is snapshotted for restore.

actions.title: Classic Windows context menu
actions.description: Use the classic context menu for this user. Restore returns to the exact state captured before Apex changed it.

actions.title: Windows 11 context menu
actions.description: Restore the Windows 11 context menu. Restore returns to the exact state captured before Apex changed it.

actions.title: Restart Explorer
actions.description: Restart the current user's Explorer shell. Finish file operations first.

actions.title: Apex Ultimate Performance
actions.description: On AC, set processor min/max to 100% with aggressive boost. This increases heat and power use. Battery settings remain cloned from Windows Balanced.

actions.title: Apex Maximum Performance
actions.description: Create a verified Apex plan from the installed Ultimate Performance plan when present, otherwise the installed Balanced plan; apply maximum AC processor settings and verify activation.

actions.title: Apex Performance
actions.description: Select the Apex Performance plan cloned from Windows Balanced.

actions.title: Apex Balanced
actions.description: Select an Apex plan cloned from the Windows Balanced defaults.

actions.title: Apex Power Saver
actions.description: Select a cloned plan with lower processor maximum on AC and battery power. Verify behavior on your hardware.

actions.title: Apex Laptop Performance
actions.description: Select a laptop-aware plan. Battery processor limits are lower than AC limits.

actions.title: Apex Custom
actions.description: Clone the currently available Windows plan, verify and activate it, then customize its settings in Windows Power Options. Restore returns to the plan that was active before Apex switched.

actions.title: Power Plan Diagnostics
actions.description: List real Windows power-plan GUIDs and detect which processor controls are supported on this system.

actions.title: Select an installed Windows power plan
actions.description: Choose and activate an exact power plan currently enumerated by Windows. Apex saves the previously active scheme GUID and verifies the selected scheme after activation.

actions.title: Use Available Plan
actions.description: Select the installed Windows Balanced plan, or keep the current active plan when Windows Balanced is unavailable.

actions.title: Installed driver inventory
actions.description: List installed driver versions, providers, dates, and device names.

actions.title: Missing and problem drivers
actions.description: Find PnP devices reporting errors, including devices reporting a missing driver. Does not install drivers.

actions.title: Export driver inventory
actions.description: Export installed signed-driver details to a timestamped CSV.

actions.title: Display driver diagnostics
actions.description: Report display devices and matched provider, version, and date.

actions.title: Network driver diagnostics
actions.description: Report network PnP devices and driver details.

actions.title: Audio driver diagnostics
actions.description: Report audio devices and driver details.

actions.title: USB driver diagnostics
actions.description: Report USB devices and driver details.

actions.title: Bluetooth driver diagnostics
actions.description: Report Bluetooth devices and driver details.

actions.title: Search Windows Update for drivers
actions.description: Search for applicable driver updates only; nothing is installed.

actions.title: Diagnose network connectivity
actions.description: Check adapter/PnP status, gateway, TCP reachability, and DNS. No driver or adapter reset.

actions.title: Safe network recovery
actions.description: Flush DNS only when gateway/TCP succeed and DNS fails; re-test afterward. No driver reinstall or reboot.

actions.title: Reset Winsock catalog
actions.description: ADVANCED: save current network state, request a Windows Winsock reset, and restart Windows before retesting connectivity. This can disrupt VPNs or custom network software.

actions.title: Reset TCP/IP stack
actions.description: ADVANCED: save current network state, request a Windows TCP/IP reset, and restart Windows before retesting. Custom static IP/DNS configuration may need to be re-entered.

actions.title: Optional consumer app inventory
actions.description: List only Apex's allowlisted current-user consumer apps. Protected runtimes and system services are excluded.

actions.title: Windows release compatibility
actions.description: Show Windows edition, 26H2 release detection, build, and architecture. Apex does not claim untested builds are compatible.

actions.title: Remove Clipchamp for current user
actions.description: Unregister Clipchamp only for the current user. Restore depends on Windows retaining its package manifest.

actions.title: Remove News for current user
actions.description: Unregister Microsoft.BingNews only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Get Help for current user
actions.description: Unregister Get Help only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Tips for current user
actions.description: Unregister Get Started/Tips only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Solitaire for current user
actions.description: Unregister Solitaire only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Feedback Hub for current user
actions.description: Unregister Feedback Hub only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Maps for current user
actions.description: Unregister Maps only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Movies & TV for current user
actions.description: Unregister Zune Video only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove People for current user
actions.description: Unregister People only for the current user. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Copilot app for current user
actions.description: Unregister the standalone Copilot package only when present. This does not alter Windows Copilot policy or shared runtimes.

actions.title: Defender and Firewall status
actions.description: Read Microsoft Defender real-time protection, signature age, and Windows Firewall profiles. Apex does not change or disable security protections.

actions.title: Limit ad ID and diagnostic personalization
actions.description: Turn off this user's Advertising ID and diagnostic-data personalization. Original values are saved for Restore; Windows Security and required diagnostics are unchanged.

actions.title: Google Chrome
actions.description: Install Chrome from the exact Google.Chrome WinGet package using Microsoft's WinGet source. Does not change the default browser.

actions.title: Mozilla Firefox
actions.description: Install Firefox from the exact Mozilla.Firefox WinGet package using Microsoft's WinGet source. Does not change the default browser.

actions.title: Brave
actions.description: Install Brave from the exact Brave.Brave WinGet package using Microsoft's WinGet source. Does not change the default browser.

actions.title: Steam
actions.description: Install the Valve.Steam package from the WinGet source when you choose Install.

actions.title: Epic Games Launcher
actions.description: Install the EpicGames.EpicGamesLauncher package from the WinGet source when you choose Install.

actions.title: OBS Studio
actions.description: Install OBS Studio from the exact OBSProject.OBSStudio WinGet package when selected.

actions.title: NanaZip
actions.description: Install NanaZip from the exact MouriNaruto.NanaZip WinGet package. Windows ZIP support is not removed.

actions.title: 7-Zip
actions.description: Install 7-Zip from the exact 7zip.7zip WinGet package when selected.

actions.title: Minecraft Launcher
actions.description: Optional Microsoft/Mojang launcher install. Gaming Services and Xbox authentication are not removed or modified.

actions.title: Remove Teams personal for current user
actions.description: Unregister MSTeams only for the current user. Work/school Teams packages are not targeted.

actions.title: Remove Cortana app for current user
actions.description: Unregister the legacy Cortana app package only if present. Restore depends on the staged package manifest.

actions.title: Remove Mail and Calendar for current user
actions.description: Unregister Windows Communications Apps only for the current user. Restore may require its package manifest to remain staged.

actions.title: Microsoft Store status
actions.description: Detect the current user's Store package. Edge Browser and WebView2 are separate components.

actions.title: Remove Microsoft Store for current user
actions.description: Optional current-user package removal can affect Store installs and updates. Restore may fail if Windows removes the staged manifest.

actions.title: Edge Browser detection
actions.description: Detect the Edge browser executable only. Apex does not remove Edge or WebView2.

actions.title: WebView2 Runtime detection
actions.description: Detect the shared WebView2 Runtime separately from the Edge browser. Apex never removes WebView2.

actions.title: Repair/check WebView2 Runtime
actions.description: Run a user-staged official Microsoft Evergreen installer, then verify WebView2. Edge Browser is not modified; Apex does not download or bundle the installer.

actions.title: Chrome detection and default status
actions.description: Detect Chrome and check current HTTP/HTTPS associations. Chrome is not bundled or installed by Apex.

actions.title: Set Chrome as default browser
actions.description: Open Windows Default apps for Chrome. Select and approve associations in Windows; protected UserChoice hashes are not edited.

actions.title: Chrome background behavior
actions.description: Open Chrome's system settings so you can disable background apps when Chrome closes.

actions.title: NanaZip detection
actions.description: Detect the current user's NanaZip package. Apex does not bundle the application.

actions.title: NanaZip archive associations
actions.description: Inspect common archive formats and open Windows Default apps for NanaZip. UserChoice hashes are not bypassed.

actions.title: Configure NanaZip associations
actions.description: Open Windows Default apps for NanaZip. Assign formats supported by your installed NanaZip version in Windows.

actions.title: Apex Dark theme
actions.description: Set current-user app and system theme preferences to dark; original registry values are saved for Restore.

actions.title: Apex Light theme
actions.description: Set current-user app and system theme preferences to light; original registry values are saved for Restore.

actions.title: Reduce transparency
actions.description: Turn off the current-user Windows transparency preference. Restore returns to the captured setting.

actions.title: Enable transparency
actions.description: Turn on the current-user Windows transparency preference. Restore returns to the captured setting.

actions.title: Apex wallpaper library
actions.description: Browse every supported image in Wallpapers, including custom files. Refresh to detect newly added images.

actions.title: DISM health check
actions.description: Check whether the Windows component store is marked corrupted; this does not repair it.

actions.title: DISM scan health
actions.description: Scan the Windows component store without applying repairs.

actions.title: Repair Windows components
actions.description: Run DISM RestoreHealth. Requires elevation and may need network access.

actions.title: Verify system files
actions.description: Run SFC verify-only mode; no files are repaired.

actions.title: Windows Update diagnostics
actions.description: Inspect update services and recent Windows Update errors without changing them.

actions.title: Repair Windows Update cache
actions.description: Stop active update services, rename caches to timestamped backups, and restart services. Restore returns the prior cache folders; no reboot is performed.

actions.title: Windows Installer diagnostics
actions.description: Inspect the Installer service and registration state.

actions.title: Re-register Windows Installer
actions.description: Run msiexec unregister/register. Requires elevation; no reboot is requested.

actions.title: Restart Explorer shell
actions.description: Restart Explorer for the current user. Finish file operations first.

actions.title: Gaming Services diagnostics
actions.description: Inspect Gaming Services packages and services without removing or reinstalling them.

actions.title: Microsoft/Xbox sign-in diagnostics
actions.description: Inspect Xbox identity packages and sign-in services without changing authentication components.

actions.title: WinRE diagnostics
actions.description: Query Windows Recovery Environment status; does not reconfigure recovery.

actions.title: Generate Apex diagnostic report
actions.description: Collect hardware, Windows, drivers, adapters, startup, services, and active plan into Apex-System-Report.txt.

actions.title: Repair system files
actions.description: Run DISM health repair followed by System File Checker. Requires elevation and may take a long time.

actions.title: Create Windows restore point
actions.description: Request a restore point before broader changes. Requires elevation and System Protection.

actions.title: Create Apex configuration backup
actions.description: Archive Apex configuration, scripts, and managed-setting snapshots; this is not a Windows image.

actions.title: Restore Apex configuration backup
actions.description: Restore configuration and managed-setting snapshots from the latest Apex archive. This does not restore Windows itself.
